profile.name: Juan Lopez
profile.tagline: I build web applications and software solutions, with a special interest in artificial intelligence, backend development, and cloud technologies.
about: I'm a Systems Engineering student at Universidad del Valle, interested in software development, artificial intelligence, and building applications that solve real problems.

I've worked on academic and personal projects using technologies like TypeScript, React, Angular, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS. I'm currently also exploring generative AI applications and RAG-based systems.
I enjoy learning new technologies by building projects and following good practices in architecture, testing, automation, and deployment.

projects.title: IoT Environmental Monitoring
projects.description: Environmental monitoring system built with ESP32-S3 that collects sensor data and transmits it via MQTT. The solution uses EMQX as the broker, Node.js for processing, and a Telegram bot to query and receive system information.
